newsitem.title: LATVIA: Olainfarm slides on sleepy Latvian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Olainfarm slides on sleepy Latvian bourse.

text.p: Latvia's bourse remained sluggish on Wednesday, with all official list shares holding steady and Olainfarm sliding.
Overall market volume was a sleepy 56,000 lats and the Rietumu index slipped 0.21 percent to 156.25.
Olainfarm, a pharmeceutical company which made its market debut on Monday, was the most active share in trade of 15,700 lats as it lost 14.7 percent to 2.09 lats.
Some dealers have said that the company, which was first quoted at 2.49 lats, was overpriced from the start in light of its first quarter results, which were poor. Others were more generous.
"In the long run, the company looks OK," said Andreta Petersone, a broker with Hansabank-Latvija.
"The recent results showed problems stemming from previous management...the first half results will be a more reliable indicator," she added.
